<includeonly>{{#invoke:CardMiniDB|main|template=Armada|set={{{set}}}}}</includeonly><noinclude>

This template is for use citing individual cards from [[Star Wars: Armada|''Star Wars'': Armada's]] expansion packs and campaign expansions.

==Usage==
Place the following code on the page and replace "SET NAME," "CARD NAME," and "URL" with the appropriate information. The URL should link to the card's page on the [[w:c:starwars-armada|Star Wars: Armada Wiki]].
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>Armada|set=SET NAME|cardname=CARD NAME|link=URL}}

===Examples===
<code><nowiki>{{Armada|set=Imperial Light Cruiser Expansion Pack|cardname=''Hand of Justice''|link=https://starwars-armada.fandom.com/wiki/Hand_of_Justice}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Armada|set=Imperial Light Cruiser Expansion Pack|cardname=''Hand of Justice''|link=https://starwars-armada.fandom.com/wiki/Hand_of_Justice}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{Armada|set=Core Set|cardname=''Dominator''|link=https://starwars-armada.fandom.com/wiki/Dominator}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Armada|set=Core Set|cardname=''Dominator''|link=https://starwars-armada.fandom.com/wiki/Dominator}}
